##    New Product SOLUTIONS

#### Ranger® Waste & Recycling Solutions

High-capacity waste containers with a choice of dual-hinged door or 4-opening lid configurations to
conceal waste, control odors, and simplify disposal. Fade-resistant modern color finishes and
durable construction ensure long-lasting performance.

[ Explore Ranger Now ][61]

#### Fulfill Waste & Recycling Solutions

Built for high-traffic commercial environments, with weather-resistant durability, modern color
finishes, and flexible configurations to fit your facility's waste and recycling needs.

[ Explore Now ][62]

#### Glass Cleaning Solutions

Windows, mirrors, and glass surfaces play a key role in the look and feel of any professional space
and often shape perceptions of overall cleanliness. This new suite of glass cleaning tools delivers
an ergonomic, effective, streak-free clean across all glass surfaces.

[ NEW! Glass Cleaning Solutions ][63]

#### CirculAir 90™ Passive Air Care Refills & Dispenser

Refill and Dispenser feature a battery-free design for uninterrupted performance and 90 days or more
of maintenance-free fragrance. Refill is independently validated to meet key recycling system
requirements and design guidelines in the USA.

[ Explore CirculAir90 Products ][64]

#### BRUTE Tilt Truck Lids and Organization

Optimize your Tilt Truck with new accessories — including the caddy with an ergonomic handle,
integrated trash bag dispenser, and tool clip system, as well as redesigned lids for increased
capacity.

[ Explore BRUTE Tilt Truck Accessories ][65]

#### BRUTE Farm Feeding Solutions

Built to endure the toughest conditions, BRUTE farm feeders are made to perform day in and day out,
season after season and all are backed by a category-leading 10-Year Limited Warranty.

[ Learn More ][66]

#### HYGEN™ r-40 Recycled Microfiber Cloths

Featuring the same superior performance and durability of HYGEN but now with the added benefit of
sustainability. Made with 40% post-consumer recycled polyester, that reuses plastic bottle material
and reduces use of virgin plastics.

[ Learn More ][67]

#### Next Generation Housekeeping Carts & Accessories

Designed to address the critical needs of housekeeping professionals, these carts provide a solution
that elevates efficiency and satisfaction through improved organization, easy maneuverability, and a
premium aesthetic.

[ Learn More ][68]

###    explore more

#### New Microfiber Pathogen Removal Claims

Candida auris is an emerging, often multi-drug resistant fungus found in healthcare settings. Our
HYGEN™ Durable and Disposable Microfiber products remove 99.99% of C. auris. Learn more about the
tested efficacy and efficiencies of RCP microfiber products.

[ Learn more ][69]

#### Iconic Durability Since 1968

For over 50 years, BRUTE® has delivered unparalleled durability, quality, and reliability; backed by
an industry-leading 10-year warranty.

[ Explore BRUTE ][70]

#### Augmented Reality

Virtually place true-to-scale products in your space to ensure the right size & design before you
buy.

[ Explore Now ][71]

#### Get Custom Waste Stream Labeling

We've partnered with SpecialMade Goods and Services® so you can work with customization specialists
to easily design your own labels.

[ Get Labels ][72]

###   industry insights

#### Property Management

As businesses return to offices, ensure that employee health and safety is a top priority with
industry-leading products that also complement building aesthetics.

[ Visit Page ][73]

#### Retail

Shoppers have new expectations when it comes to hygiene in retail stores. Welcome customers to a
visibly cleaner store with product recommendations and high touch cleaning guidance.

[ Visit Page ][74]

#### Manufacturing and Distribution Centers

Strive for a new level of cleanliness to keep employees safe and ensure productivity in
manufacturing and distribution centers.

[ Visit Page ][75]

#### K-12 Schools

Students, parents, and staff have new concerns about the cleanliness of their schools. Prepare for
the school year with high touch cleaning guidance and product recommendations for a cleaner
facility.

[ Visit Page ][76]

#### Higher Education

College and university campuses have changed drastically since COVID-19. Provide students, faculty,
and staff with a safe, clean environment using high touch cleaning guidance and tailored product
recommendations.

[ Visit Page ][77]

#### Acute Care

Hospitals need to make sure patients feel safe when seeking care. Ensure the health and safety of
patients and staff by developing cleaning processes for high touch areas and implementing product
recommendations throughout the facility.

[ Visit Page ][78]

#### Long Term Care

Nursing homes and assisted living facilities have a heightened responsibility to keep high-risk
residents safe. Implement thorough cleaning and safety procedures to prevent the spread of illness.

[ Visit Page ][79]

#### Foodservice and Restaurants

Patrons have high expectations of cleanliness in restaurants. Keep patrons safe while dining by
implementing efficient cleaning processes, both in front of house and back of house areas.

[ Visit Page ][80]

#### Stadiums and Arenas

As patrons seek to return to entertainment experiences after COVID-19, stadiums and arenas need to
meet higher expectations of cleanliness. Improve the perception of clean with products and processes
to help staff clean and disinfect effectively.

[ Visit Page ][81]

#### Hospitality

Hotels and resorts need to prepare for heightened expectations of cleanliness as patrons return to
regular travel. Ensure patron health and safety is a top priority with product recommendations and
cleaning guidance specifically created for hospitality.

[ Visit Page ][82]

Refill and Dispenser feature a battery-free design for uninterrupted performance and 90 days or more
of maintenance-free fragrance. Refill is independently validated to meet key recycling system
requirements and design guidelines in the USA.

[ Explore CirculAir90 Products ][64]

#### BRUTE Tilt Truck Lids and Organization

Optimize your Tilt Truck with new accessories — including the caddy with an ergonomic handle,
integrated trash bag dispenser, and tool clip system, as well as redesigned lids for increased
capacity.

[ Explore BRUTE Tilt Truck Accessories ][65]

#### BRUTE Farm Feeding Solutions

Built to endure the toughest conditions, BRUTE farm feeders are made to perform day in and day out,
season after season and all are backed by a category-leading 10-Year Limited Warranty.

[ Learn More ][66]

#### HYGEN™ r-40 Recycled Microfiber Cloths

Featuring the same superior performance and durability of HYGEN but now with the added benefit of
sustainability. Made with 40% post-consumer recycled polyester, that reuses plastic bottle material
and reduces use of virgin plastics.

[ Learn More ][67]

#### Next Generation Housekeeping Carts & Accessories

Designed to address the critical needs of housekeeping professionals, these carts provide a solution
that elevates efficiency and satisfaction through improved organization, easy maneuverability, and a
premium aesthetic.

[ Learn More ][68]

###    explore more

#### New Microfiber Pathogen Removal Claims

Candida auris is an emerging, often multi-drug resistant fungus found in healthcare settings. Our
HYGEN™ Durable and Disposable Microfiber products remove 99.99% of C. auris. Learn more about the
tested efficacy and efficiencies of RCP microfiber products.

[ Learn more ][69]

#### Iconic Durability Since 1968

For over 50 years, BRUTE® has delivered unparalleled durability, quality, and reliability; backed by
an industry-leading 10-year warranty.

[ Explore BRUTE ][70]

#### Augmented Reality

Virtually place true-to-scale products in your space to ensure the right size & design before you
buy.

[ Explore Now ][71]

#### Get Custom Waste Stream Labeling

We've partnered with SpecialMade Goods and Services® so you can work with customization specialists
to easily design your own labels.

[ Get Labels ][72]

###   industry insights

#### Property Management

As businesses return to offices, ensure that employee health and safety is a top priority with
industry-leading products that also complement building aesthetics.

[ Visit Page ][73]

#### Retail

Shoppers have new expectations when it comes to hygiene in retail stores. Welcome customers to a
visibly cleaner store with product recommendations and high touch cleaning guidance.

[ Visit Page ][74]

#### Manufacturing and Distribution Centers

Strive for a new level of cleanliness to keep employees safe and ensure productivity in
manufacturing and distribution centers.

[ Visit Page ][75]

#### K-12 Schools

Students, parents, and staff have new concerns about the cleanliness of their schools. Prepare for
the school year with high touch cleaning guidance and product recommendations for a cleaner
facility.

[ Visit Page ][76]

#### Higher Education

College and university campuses have changed drastically since COVID-19. Provide students, faculty,
and staff with a safe, clean environment using high touch cleaning guidance and tailored product
recommendations.

[ Visit Page ][77]

#### Acute Care

Hospitals need to make sure patients feel safe when seeking care. Ensure the health and safety of
patients and staff by developing cleaning processes for high touch areas and implementing product
recommendations throughout the facility.

[ Visit Page ][78]

#### Long Term Care

Nursing homes and assisted living facilities have a heightened responsibility to keep high-risk
residents safe. Implement thorough cleaning and safety procedures to prevent the spread of illness.

[ Visit Page ][79]

#### Foodservice and Restaurants

Patrons have high expectations of cleanliness in restaurants. Keep patrons safe while dining by
implementing efficient cleaning processes, both in front of house and back of house areas.

[ Visit Page ][80]

#### Stadiums and Arenas

As patrons seek to return to entertainment experiences after COVID-19, stadiums and arenas need to
meet higher expectations of cleanliness. Improve the perception of clean with products and processes
to help staff clean and disinfect effectively.

[ Visit Page ][81]

#### Hospitality

Hotels and resorts need to prepare for heightened expectations of cleanliness as patrons return to
regular travel. Ensure patron health and safety is a top priority with product recommendations and
cleaning guidance specifically created for hospitality.

[ Visit Page ][82]

## ailijin**ABOUT AILIJIN**

Guangdong Dongcheng Hardware Industry Co., Ltd. was established in 1997. It is a modern industrial
and trade enterprise integrating R&D, production and sales. With 20 years of experience in the field
of stainless steel products, we are committed to providing cost-effective products to global
customers with excellent quality, innovative technology and perfect service.

The company adheres to the business philosophy of "integrity, professionalism and win-win", insists
on putting customers first and ensuring quality, serves customers with technology, and persists in
technological progress, continuous innovation and development. Your satisfaction is our pursuit! We
warmly welcome enterprises, users and consumers to contact us. We will serve you wholeheartedly with
the aim of providing good products and excellent services to users!

Focusing on **insulated lunch boxes for 20 years**, we were the first factory to propose and produce
the concepts of **"anti-overflow" and "sealing"** insulated lunch boxes. Every year, **we develop 2
to 3 new products**. From the entry of raw materials into the factory to the exit of products, all
can be independently completed within the factory, greatly avoiding defective products and

## ailijin**ABOUT AILIJIN**

Guangdong Dongcheng Hardware Industry Co., Ltd. was established in 1997. It is a modern industrial
and trade enterprise integrating R&D, production and sales. With 20 years of experience in the field
of stainless steel products, we are committed to providing cost-effective products to global
customers with excellent quality, innovative technology and perfect service.

The company adheres to the business philosophy of "integrity, professionalism and win-win", insists
on putting customers first and ensuring quality, serves customers with technology, and persists in
technological progress, continuous innovation and development. Your satisfaction is our pursuit! We
warmly welcome enterprises, users and consumers to contact us. We will serve you wholeheartedly with
the aim of providing good products and excellent services to users!

# Cold Chain Packaging Design, Engineering and Testing

Cryopak is a complete cold chain packaging solutions provider specializing in the field of
temperature-controlled packaging. From needs assessment to package qualification, Cryopak handles
your packaging projects with one paramount goal: Maintaining the integrity of your products. Our
materials and processes cover the spectrum from converting EPS or fabricating boxes to manufacturing
phase change materials and temperature monitors.

## Services

Cryopak offers a wide range of services to go along with our one-of-a-kind solutions. From testing
and qualification to recycling and reuse, we are a full-service company ready to provide you with
what you need.

[ Learn More ][86]

* ### Helping the cannabis industry
  
  Prevent mold growth without drying out the cannabinoids and terpenes, and increase shelf life by
  transporting your products within the proper temperature and humidity ranges, with our
  specifically design pallet shippers and insulated boxes.
* ### Serving the Pharmaceutical Industry
  
  The pharmaceutical industry demands stringent monitoring of your payload’s temperature. Just one
  degree off can spoil products and cause financial losses. Don’t risk it. Let Cryopak provide you
  with accurate monitoring solutions.
* ### Providing Premium Retail Products
  
  Our Ice-Pak Brand is an integral part of any lunch box or cooler. From bottles and blankets to hot
  packs and coolers, we have the solution for your every need.
* ### Keeping Food & Beverage Cold
  
  There’s no use in crying over spoiled milk. With Cryopak´s temperature and humidity monitoring
  solutions, you can track the enviroment of your product in real-time.

  factory-direct production and support for bulk orders, these bags helps courier companies,
  warehouses, and delivery services improve efficiency while keeping a neat and professional look.

  Explore the range of cold chain delivery bags — insulated soft-structure bags made to keep fresh
  produce, groceries, and medical stuff at the right temperature during delivery. Each bag can be
  fully customized in size, material, and even branding, giving businesses some flexibility to
  create solution that kinda fits their workflow. Perfect for bulk wholesale orders, these bags
  helps companies meet fast global fulfillment needs while keeping things reliable and consistent.
  Factory-direct production makes pricing competitive, and the team can scale up quickly if more
  bags are needed, making it easier for restaurants, pharmacies, and logistics providers to actually
  upgrade their delivery operations without too much hassle.

  interior lining. Reflective safety strips improve visibility. Adjustable waists, wrists , and
  ankles ensure optimal fit. Waterproof and windproof. Large front pouch fits order slips and pens.

* [Food Delivery Bags][117]
  Available for bulk orders, our professional food delivery bags are fully OEM/ODM customizable to
  meet your brand’s needs. Factory-direct and built for commercial use, you can add your logo,
  select sizes, and design custom solutions for restaurants, catering services, and delivery
  platforms. With reliable quality, competitive pricing, and scalable production, we make it easy
  for businesses to upgrade their delivery operations.
* [Rider Helmet][118]
  Enhance road safety with our B2B-customized helmets, crafted in our factory for food delivery
  professionals. They feature durable construction, reflective decals for visibility, and a
  comfortable ventilation system. Snap-on shields and side logo printing are included, with DOT,
  ECE, and CE certifications for top-tier quality assurance.
* [Parcel Delivery Bags][119]
  The Logistics Sorting Bags, made in the Yangchun factory, are designed to help logistics companies
  simplify parcel sorting and delivery. Each bag can be customized in size, material, and with
  company logo, giving business some flexibility to create solution that fits their workflow. With
  factory-direct production and support for bulk orders, these bags helps courier companies,
  warehouses, and delivery services improve efficiency while keeping a neat and professional look.
* [Cold Chain Insulated Packaging][120]
  Explore the range of cold chain delivery bags — insulated soft-structure bags made to keep fresh
  produce, groceries, and medical stuff at the right temperature during delivery. Each bag can be
  fully customized in size, material, and even branding, giving businesses some flexibility to
  create solution that kinda fits their workflow. Perfect for bulk wholesale orders, these bags
  helps companies meet fast global fulfillment needs while keeping things reliable and consistent.
  Factory-direct production makes pricing competitive, and the team can scale up quickly if more
  bags are needed, making it easier for restaurants, pharmacies, and logistics providers to actually
  upgrade their delivery operations without too much hassle.
* [Rider Uniform][121]
  All-weather protection for motorcycle food couriers. Durable exterior combined with heat-retaining
  interior lining. Reflective safety strips improve visibility. Adjustable waists, wrists , and
  ankles ensure optimal fit. Waterproof and windproof. Large front pouch fits order slips and pens.
  Finished in your brand colors with reflective logo printing.

Guangzhou A.C.T products co., Ltd. was founded in 2013, is an expert manufacturer focusing on the

base in Yangchun. We have also expanded into markets including Southeast Asia, Australia, America
Europe, and Africa. Our main products include insulated food delivery bags, takeaway delivery
helmets, takeaway delivery bikes, delivery clothing, and insulated water bottle, etc. Also, we have

# Welcome to EverythingBranded

EverythingBranded helps Canadian businesses, organizations and event teams create memorable brand
experiences with custom promotional products. From branded pens, drinkware and tote bags to logo
apparel, corporate gifts and trade show giveaways, we make it easy to find merchandise that fits
your audience, budget and deadline.

Browse a wide range of customizable products, then add your logo, artwork or campaign message. Our
team is here to help you choose the right item, prepare your design and move your order from quote
to delivery with confidence.

[Anonymous][74] reviewed [Kunefe (A Sweet Cheese Pastry made with Kadaifi)][75]
I was really interested in making Kunefee. I lived in Turkey for 5 years and have enjoyed this
dessert very much. I saved this recipe because it’s baked and not cooked over the stove, the
traditional way. I started making the syrup a day ahead of time because from the online research it
needs to be cold before you pour it on “individual slices only”right out of the oven. From reading
the reviews on this post no one mentioned anything about the syrup not getting thick. I threw my
syrup out and did a lot of research for the right ingredients. The traditional ingredients are 1 cup
of water, 2 cups of sugar, 1 tablespoon lemon juice. Add Rose when syrup is done. You heat it on
medium until sugar is dissolved and when it comes to a nice gentle boil, simmer for 12 min. Then you
will notice it has thickened nicely. Traditional Kunefee does not require milk, confectioner sugar
or nutmeg. So I made some adjustments to my recipe and I was very pleased with the results.

][73]
[Anonymous][74] reviewed [Kunefe (A Sweet Cheese Pastry made with Kadaifi)][75]
I was really interested in making Kunefee. I lived in Turkey for 5 years and have enjoyed this
dessert very much. I saved this recipe because it’s baked and not cooked over the stove, the
traditional way. I started making the syrup a day ahead of time because from the online research it
needs to be cold before you pour it on “individual slices only”right out of the oven. From reading
the reviews on this post no one mentioned anything about the syrup not getting thick. I threw my
syrup out and did a lot of research for the right ingredients. The traditional ingredients are 1 cup
of water, 2 cups of sugar, 1 tablespoon lemon juice. Add Rose when syrup is done. You heat it on
medium until sugar is dissolved and when it comes to a nice gentle boil, simmer for 12 min. Then you
will notice it has thickened nicely. Traditional Kunefee does not require milk, confectioner sugar
or nutmeg. So I made some adjustments to my recipe and I was very pleased with the results.

captain on BBQ Brawl and a judge countless cooking competition shows.

Food Network Chef

Iron Chef, and host of Beat Bobby Flay, Bobby's Triple Threat and BBQ Brawl.

[ ][137]

Food Network Chef

host of Ready Jet Cook and has appeared on dozens of Food Network shows.

## About The Company

Hoffmann Bewirtung India is the brainchild of a collection of experts and is one of the most
recognizable names in the hospitality industry for quality products in storage, handling, and
transportation of food and beverages.
Combining elegant design with supreme quality, our products fulfill the industry’s demand for
impeccable hygiene, easy storage, and maintenance of temperature– a new milestone in the hospitality
industry.
We strive to forge lasting bonds with our customers, through our commitment to delivering quality
products and after-sales services.

## Why Us?

We believe that when a chef has worked tirelessly to bring you the best, it should not be squandered
in the last mile of delivery.
This is where HBI comes in.
Our impeccable design ensures that the food you receive is just as fresh, tasty, and presentable as
when it comes out of the oven. Not only are our products visually appealing, due to our use of the
special technology of prilling, but we also emphasise quality, and that reflects in our performance.
HBI products are guaranteed an extended holding time, and are equipped with top-notch facilities.
Hygiene. Quality. Temperature.
We guarantee it all.

a cleaner, more efficient, and more standardized production environment.   Injection Molding

arrangement and production management. By optimizing machine placement and material flow, production
efficiency has been significantly enhanced while reducing unnecessary downtime.   Key improvements

storage system Enhanced quality control procedures Cleaner and more organized manufacturing

delivery performance, the assembly workshop has also been fully upgraded.   The optimized assembly
lines now provide: Higher assembly efficiency Better workflow coordination Improved product quality

Our logistics service: Noatum Logistics is renowned for its excellent service and specialised staff
who have positioned the company as an industry leader offering solutions to meet the needs of our
clients in a variety of sectors.

#### [Air freight][118]

### Air freight

We ensure seamless supply chain operations for your air logistics needs.

[Read more…][119]

#### [Ocean freight][120]

### Ocean freight

With our extensive global network of key ship carriers, we guarantee optimal space allocation and
competitive rates for your ocean cargo needs.

[Read more…][121]

#### [Inland transport][122]

### Inland transport

Our in-country teams work closely with your vendors to monitor goods availability, arrange
collection and delivery, and ensure smooth inland transportation, navigating roads daily to prevent
disruptions in your supply chain.

[Read more…][123]

### Customs brokerage

We improve operating efficiencies and cash flows by streamlining the entire lifecycle of global
trade.

[Read more…][125]

We provide value to the entire supply chain through the comprehensive management of logistics
specific to the market and with the integration of all processes, such as warehouse, transport, and
value-added services.

[Read more…][127]

### Value supply chain management

Our dedicated teams blend local knowledge and global expertise with leading-edge technology and
proven processes to create our competitive advantage.

[Read more…][129]

[Scania AB is a Swedish manufacturer of heavy trucks, buses and engines, headquartered in
Södertälje, Sweden. The company focuses on commercial vehicles for long-distance haulage,
construction and distribution, and also produces engines for marine and industrial applications.]

# Welcome to Scania

Our purpose is to drive the shift towards a sustainable transport system, creating a world of
mobility that is better for business, society and the environment.

[Scania Irizar i6s PHEV 3-axle]

## [New 11-litre Super powertrain for buses and coaches][12]

Building on the launch of our 13-litre Super powertrain for people transport, we are now expanding
the platform with a new 11-litre option — the Super 11 — designed to meet the demands of both urban
and travel operations. Our new bus and coach powertrain platform delivers up to 10% fuel savings,
and 40% lower emissions with plug-in hybrid capability. Based on the award-winning Super technology,
it ensures an efficient and flexible solution for modern transport operations.

[ Discover the new powertrain ][13]

## Euro NCAP awards Scania L-cab and P-cab top safety ratings in the utility and distribution
## segment

[Scania L series cab awarded five-stars in-euro-NCAP safer-trucks-programme]
[ L-series trucks ][14]

The L-cab for utility operations is a versatile low-entry cab designed for urban and vocational use.
It combines active safety systems, including advanced emergency braking, with passive protection
such as driver and side-curtain airbags.

[ Road safety at Scania ][15]
[Scania P series cab awarded five-stars in-euro-NCAP safer-trucks-programme]
[ P-series trucks ][16]

The P-cab for distribution combines high driving position with strong all-round visibility. It
achieved the highest score in [Euro NCAP][17]’s “CitySafe” category, recognising vehicles equipped
with features designed to prevent accidents in urban environments.

[ Press release ][18]

### [News][19]

[ [An aerial shot of Scania's industry site in Rugao, China.] ][20]

#### [Scania marks historic milestone with new global industrial hub in China][21]

Scania opens its third global industrial hub in China, further strengthening its commitment to
sustainable transport and growth in the world’s largest truck market.

[ [Scania truck on a road summertime] ][22]

#### [Scania Performance Summary Q2][23]

Scania performed strongly during the second quarter of 2026. Truck order intake increased
significantly, vehicle deliveries rose and service revenues continued to grow compared with the same
period last year. 

[ [Autonomous truck sensor] ][24]

#### [Autonomous trucks can help address transport industry’s driver shortage issue][25]

Will driverless vehicles reduce the need for human drivers? At Scania, we believe technology and
people will complement each other.

[ [An electric Scania truck for bulk transport.] ][26]

#### [Scania in landmark deal to sell 105 battery-electric trucks to Wibax][27]

Scania has signed a landmark deal with Wibax for 105 battery-electric trucks, helping scale
sustainable bulk transport across the Nordic region.

[ Go to our newsroom ][28]

### Scania introduces - the new Super 11-litre engine

Scania launches a new member in the Scania Super family – the Super 11 engine. A lighter, more
efficient solution for high-performance transport. With a compact footprint, up to 7 percent fuel
savings and Scania’s signature engineering intelligence, the new Super 11 engine expands the Super
powertrain portfolio to meet the needs of weight-sensitive and energy-efficient applications.

[ Discover Super 11 ][29]
[ [Super 11] ][30]
[Two Scania employees in the gearbox assembly in Södertälje]

## [We drive real change][31]

With some 58,000 employees in more than 100 countries,  Scania is a truly global player. At Scania
you’ll be part of a company with over 130-year track record of innovation, as we continue on our
ambitious journey to drive the shift towards sustainable transport.

[Join the Scania team][32]
[ [ Scania steering wheel] ][33]

### [Transport solutions][34]

By combining smart transport solutions, technological innovation and partnerships, we’re working to
make sustainable transport a reality.

[Discover Scania’s transport solutions][35]
[ [ scania truck on a bridge] ][36]

### [Our commitments][37]

Our Science based targets commits us to reduce emissions at the scale and pace science dictates
necessary to limit global warming.

[Scania’s sustainability commitments][38]
[ [View from the windshield in a Scania 25 P BEV 4x2 general cargo transport] ][39]

Scania provides a wide range of safety solutions to protect driver

[Scania AB is a Swedish manufacturer of heavy trucks, buses and engines, headquartered in
Södertälje, Sweden. The company focuses on commercial vehicles for long-distance haulage,
construction and distribution, and also produces engines for marine and industrial applications.]

# Welcome to Scania

Our purpose is to drive the shift towards a sustainable transport system, creating a world of
mobility that is better for business, society and the environment.

[Scania Irizar i6s PHEV 3-axle]

## [New 11-litre Super powertrain for buses and coaches][12]

Building on the launch of our 13-litre Super powertrain for people transport, we are now expanding
the platform with a new 11-litre option — the Super 11 — designed to meet the demands of both urban
and travel operations. Our new bus and coach powertrain platform delivers up to 10% fuel savings,
and 40% lower emissions with plug-in hybrid capability. Based on the award-winning Super technology,
it ensures an efficient and flexible solution for modern transport operations.

[ Discover the new powertrain ][13]

## Euro NCAP awards Scania L-cab and P-cab top safety ratings in the utility and distribution
## segment

[Scania L series cab awarded five-stars in-euro-NCAP safer-trucks-programme]
[ L-series trucks ][14]

The L-cab for utility operations is a versatile low-entry cab designed for urban and vocational use.
It combines active safety systems, including advanced emergency braking, with passive protection
such as driver and side-curtain airbags.

[ Road safety at Scania ][15]
[Scania P series cab awarded five-stars in-euro-NCAP safer-trucks-programme]
[ P-series trucks ][16]

The P-cab for distribution combines high driving position with strong all-round visibility. It
achieved the highest score in [Euro NCAP][17]’s “CitySafe” category, recognising vehicles equipped
with features designed to prevent accidents in urban environments.

[ Press release ][18]

### [News][19]

[ [An aerial shot of Scania's industry site in Rugao, China.] ][20]

#### [Scania marks historic milestone with new global industrial hub in China][21]

Scania opens its third global industrial hub in China, further strengthening its commitment to
sustainable transport and growth in the world’s largest truck market.

[ [Scania truck on a road summertime] ][22]

#### [Scania Performance Summary Q2][23]

Scania performed strongly during the second quarter of 2026. Truck order intake increased
significantly, vehicle deliveries rose and service revenues continued to grow compared with the same
period last year. 

[ [Autonomous truck sensor] ][24]

#### [Autonomous trucks can help address transport industry’s driver shortage issue][25]

Will driverless vehicles reduce the need for human drivers? At Scania, we believe technology and
people will complement each other.

[ [An electric Scania truck for bulk transport.] ][26]

#### [Scania in landmark deal to sell 105 battery-electric trucks to Wibax][27]

Scania has signed a landmark deal with Wibax for 105 battery-electric trucks, helping scale
sustainable bulk transport across the Nordic region.

[ Go to our newsroom ][28]

### Scania introduces - the new Super 11-litre engine

Scania launches a new member in the Scania Super family – the Super 11 engine. A lighter, more
efficient solution for high-performance transport. With a compact footprint, up to 7 percent fuel
savings and Scania’s signature engineering intelligence, the new Super 11 engine expands the Super
powertrain portfolio to meet the needs of weight-sensitive and energy-efficient applications.

[ Discover Super 11 ][29]
[ [Super 11] ][30]
[Two Scania employees in the gearbox assembly in Södertälje]

## [We drive real change][31]

With some 58,000 employees in more than 100 countries,  Scania is a truly global player. At Scania
you’ll be part of a company with over 130-year track record of innovation, as we continue on our
ambitious journey to drive the shift towards sustainable transport.

[Join the Scania team][32]
[ [ Scania steering wheel] ][33]

By combining smart transport solutions, technological innovation and partnerships, we’re working to
make sustainable transport a reality.

[Discover Scania’s transport solutions][35]

Our Science based targets commits us to reduce emissions at the scale and pace science dictates

## Der Maßstab für Thermobehälter und Regale

Seit 1978 sind wir Markt- und Qualitätsführer in der Herstellung von Thermobehältern. Als Spezialist
und Systemanbieter für den Tiefkühl- und Frischetransport kooperieren wir mit allen großen
Lebensmittelketten. Moderne Schraub- und Schwerlastregale fertigen wir in Deutschland und bieten
hiermit „Made in Germany“ Qualität und höchste Flexibilität für unsere Kunden an.

## Beste Qualität

Modernste Fertigungsstraßen und ein ständig angepasstes Maschinenmanagement sichern unsere
Termintreue und unsere Lieferfähigkeit. Eine hohe Fertigungstiefe erlaubt flexible Anpassungen an
die Wünsche unserer Kunden. Alle operativen Unternehmensprozesse unterliegen einem strengen
Qualitätsmanagement.

## Made in Germany

Auf rund 16.000 qm Produktionsfläche stellen unsere hochqualifizierten Mitarbeiter am Standort
Arnsberg unsere TKT-Thermobehälter und TKT-Regale her. Unsere Produkte werden vollständig in
Deutschland hergestellt. Die genauen Kenntnisse über die Anforderungen unserer Kunden und die
kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Produkte bürgen ebenso für höchste Qualität.

## International

Unsere TKT-Thermobehälter und TKT-Regale sind überall verfügbar. Unsere Niederlassungen und Partner
weltweit sorgen für professionelle Beratung und Betreuung unserer Kunden vor Ort. Als weltweit
agierendes Unternehmen bieten wir einen kontinuierlichen Service oder unterstützen Sie gerne bei der
Auswahl der richtigen Produkte für Ihre Anforderungen.

# Entdecken Sie unsere Produkte

## TKT-Thermobehälter

TKT-Thermobehälter stehen für eine sichere und nachhaltige  Lösungen beim Transport von Frisch- und
Tiefkühlkost. Die Idee, mit gekühlten oder gefrorenen Produkten auch die Kühlhauskälte zu
transportieren, haben wir mit unseren Thermobehältern konsequent umgesetzt. TKT-Thermobehälter sind
die sicherste Methode zum Transport von temperaturgeführter Ware ohne Unterbrechung der Kühlkette.
* Effizienter Kühltransport
* Senken der Fuhrparkkosten
* Konservieren der Kühlhauskälte über 24 Stunden
* Nachhaltiges Logistikkonzept
* Höchste Flexibilität in Ihren Prozessen
* Zertifizierung nach HACCP/ATP

[mehr Informationen][28]

## TKT-Regale

TKT-Regale stehen für höchste Qualität für den Regalbau im privaten Sektor. Die einfache Montage und
die hohen Traglasten sorgen für Ordnung in Ihren Räumlichkeiten. TKT-Regale sind die beste
Möglichkeit für Ordnung zu sorgen. Die Steck- und Schraubregale mit höchsten Qualitätsansprüchen
gehören in jeden Haushalt.
* Made in Germany
* Einfache Montage
* Hohe Traglast pro Boden für höchste Ansprüche
* TÜV/GS zertifiziert

[mehr Informationen][29]

[Review FAQs↘][36]
What services does Weorex provide?+

Weorex operates across multiple business divisions including product sourcing, merchant exports, OEM
manufacturing, food production, agricultural products, packaging solutions, and digital services
through Zeo Create.

Do you provide both export and digital services?+

Yes. Weorex supports sourcing, manufacturing, and export operations, while digital services such as
website development, software development, API integrations, ecommerce solutions, and business
automation are delivered through our Zeo Create division.

Can Weorex support OEM and private label requirements?+

Yes. We help businesses develop products through OEM manufacturing and private label production
while coordinating sourcing, quality control, production oversight, and export readiness
requirements.

Who is Weorex best suited for?+

Weorex is designed for businesses seeking reliable sourcing, manufacturing, export support, or
digital solutions. We work with startups, growing brands, manufacturers, importers, distributors,
and international B2B companies.
